settings.title: 30-Day Return Window & Conditions
settings.content:
You can return any unworn, unwashed item purchased on the Liu Jo boutique within 30 calendar days from delivery.

  • Products must not have been worn, altered, or washed.
  • Original tags and packaging must be attached.
  • Footwear must be returned in the original shoe box.

settings.title: Refund Timing & Method
settings.content: Refunds are initiated once the warehouse has inspected the returned goods (up to 7-10 business days). Funds reflect on your card or account within 3 to 5 business days.

settings.panel_subheading: We want you to love your Liu Jo purchase. If you need to make a return, our process is fast and complimentary.
